referenceBuild: Captured Grok snapshots October19–21; observed live desktop 0.75.0. Required 0.78.1 update is pending user approval.
method: Revisit the historical G1–G14 gap list against the current source and real-loop tests. Prompt/catalog assertions establish surface parity only; live outcomes are reported separately.

areas.area: Turn endings and sibling tool calls
areas.evidence: delivery-batch and real Pi parity-loop tests execute sibling calls and bound failure holds to two
platform-system-prompt and managed routines skill include implicit needs and finite/self-expiring watches; durable task waiting is an additional mechanism
Worker done/partial/blocked reporting and outside-dependency rules remain. ReportTaskProgress adds host-owned waiting without abusing terminating WakeParent.
Existing routine lifecycle/schedule infrastructure is reused; this change does not introduce a second scheduler.
Self-contained parent task, outcome scope, original values and follow-up identity remain; accepted scope is now durable.
Explicit approval remains scoped to destination/purpose/limits. No new fee, changed commitment, read-only mutation or refusal workaround is authorized by progress or recovery.

areas.status: existing safety plus clarified destination scope
areas.evidence: Third-party content grants no permission; email/Slack drafting routes remain. Website approval does not become email approval.
Completion revival retains blocked/partial rules. Nonterminal progress does not consume partial redispatch or terminate a working task.

OpenTeam retains a bounded fallback when a user-origin turn produced no outward delivery. Hidden wakes and a successful background dispatch do not receive a closing nudge; delivery-failure tests cover this behavior.
Unanswered/dismissed widget echoes are acknowledged per context. An unrelated new message is not permission; pending task scope survives it.
Task has self-contained briefs, resume identity, private worker reports and automatic completion delivery; tested by graphical delegation and real queue integration.
Saved routines and parent instructions do not authorize unrelated recipients or publications. New chronological updates supersede conflicting old permission.
Answer outstanding questions, close completed interactive exchanges politely and retain unresolved work. Product instructions contain no provider/scenario-specific wording.

areas.area: Identity, acknowledgement, clocks and tool modality
areas.status: mostly existing instruction parity with local tool adaptations
areas.evidence: Action-first acknowledgement, parent-owned private handoffs and clock context exist. Native browser and secure-form adapters remain OpenTeam implementations; no claim of identical internals.

securityAndPrivacyRetained: Protected credential/state files and symlink targets cannot be delivered as ordinary attachments
Secure forms and existing connector authentication remain the routes for credentials and grants
No password, PIN or token belongs in task milestone records
Progress and continuation are private worker/parent communication, not new external sending authority
Read-only restrictions, declined actions, cancellation, changed terms and recipient limits remain effective
External-action uncertainty requires authoritative state reconciliation, not blind replay
Grok evidence collection exports only the created benchmark conversation; screenshots crop to its main pane

additionalRegressionRun.limits: These are targeted reruns and overlap the broader suites. They do not establish live Grok reliability, semantic safety in all tasks, or identical model behavior.

liveEvidence.grok075Pilot: One completed case passed provider/scope/transcript gates; post-outcome screenshot collection hit mandatory client update. Retain collection caveat and version separation.
liveEvidence.securityNegativeCases: Latest 490 read-only, cancellation, fee refusal and changed appointment terms passed provider/transcript checks; no duplicate or unauthorized action. Scope-narrowing and stale-tab cases are in progress.
liveEvidence.controlPolicy: No app security/privacy controls, secure-form routes, file delivery restrictions or connector permissions changed.

stagedClientReadOnlyReview.source: Local installed and staged application coordinator bundles, SHA-256 recorded in ignored findings/grok-staged-review-2026-10-28/static-parity-review.json
stagedClientReadOnlyReview.finding: Both expose task-list and running-subagent metadata; staged bundle includes tool-name entries. Client schemas do not reveal cloud waiting/continuation semantics. No basis for claiming identical internals.
stagedClientReadOnlyReview.privacy: Only application code/package metadata read; no user settings, session databases or credentials copied. App not restarted. No vendor code added to product repository.

cachePreservation.observed: Source490moving tail snapshot prevented conversation-prefix reuse in two live support trials; high estimated cost retained.
cachePreservation.change: Private host snapshots now persist in existing Pi transcript on change. They are hidden from UI and do not start another turn.
cachePreservation.verification: Actual serialized provider requests preserve prior prefix, including when snapshot advances; latest state and scope remain in four consecutive compactions. Fresh live cost validation pending.
